sentences.zh: 二月遷。理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: Second month, transferred. Board of Colonial Affairs Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred in the second month; appointed Right Vice Minister of the Board of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一月遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred in the eleventh month; appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙亥遷。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, yihai day, transferred.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred in the twelfth month, on yihai day.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌遷。己亥左副都御史。

translations.literal: Third month, bingxu day, transferred. Jihai day, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingxu day, transferred; on jihai day appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
